name: The King's Final Act
source:
You're a detective. On a slow night like any other, you get a call. There's been a murder at Chambers University. The voice on the other end seems to believe that you're the only one that can figure out what happened. The scene that was set before you arrive is off, and it's up to you to figure out why.

[From [url=https://neonjax.itch.io/the-kings-final-act]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名侦探。在一个像平常一样缓慢的夜晚，你接到一个电话。钱伯斯大学发生了一起谋杀案。另一端的声音似乎相信你是唯一能弄清楚发生了什么的人。在你到达之前设定的场景已经消失，由你来找出原因。

[来自[url=https://neonjax.itch.io/the-kings-final-act]Itch.io[/url]]
